title: (UPI) – ZX Bank Asia
text:
# Unified Payments Interface (UPI) – ZX Bank Asia

Unified Payments Interface (UPI) is a real-time payment system that enables instant money transfer between bank accounts using your mobile device. ZX Bank Asia supports UPI seamlessly through its mobile app for fast, secure, and convenient transactions.

## 💡 What is UPI?

Instant, 24x7 money transfers via mobile devices

Single app for accessing multiple bank accounts

Easy transactions using mobile number, Virtual Payment Address (VPA), or QR codes

Used for: Fund transfer, bill payments, merchant payments, and more

## 📱 How to Activate UPI with ZX Bank

Download the ZX Bank Asia App

Available for: Android and iOS

Login/Register

Use mobile number registered with ZX Bank

Complete e-KYC if not already done

Go to UPI Section

Tap ‘UPI’ icon or navigate via home screen

Create or Link UPI ID (VPA)

Example: yourname@zxbank

Choose/set your UPI PIN for secure transactions

Link Your ZX Bank Account

Select the account to operate UPI with

Set/Reset UPI PIN

Authenticate with debit card details

Set a 4/6-digit UPI PIN

Ready to Use

Start transacting, paying bills, transferring funds, and scanning UPI QR codes

## 🏦 UPI Daily Limits with ZX Bank

*Limits as per NPCI & ZX Bank policies. Subject to change.
**May vary based on customer risk profile and regulatory updates.

## 🛠️ UPI Customer Support

In-App: Use ‘Help & Support’ section in ZX Bank Asia App > UPI

Call: ZX Bank Customer Care: 1800-XXX-XXXX (toll-free in India)

Email: upi.support@zxbank.asia

Chat: Ask “Zia” – ZX Bank’s AI assistant – in the app for UPI help

Note:
- UPI services currently available in India for ZX Bank account holders
- For cross-border payments/remittances, use dedicated remittance options in the app

Last updated: June 2024

title: Agriculture Loan

title: Apply for a Cheque Book
text:
# How to Apply for a Cheque Book at ZX Bank

Applying for a cheque book from ZX Bank is simple and can be done through multiple convenient channels. Follow the steps below to request your new cheque book.

## 1. Via ZX Bank Mobile App

Login: Open the ZX Bank Asia app and log in using your credentials or biometric authentication.

Navigate: Go to Services or Request Services on the home menu.

Select: Tap on Cheque Book Request.

Choose Account: Select the account for which you need the cheque book.

Confirm Details: Enter delivery address (if different from registered address).

Submit: Review and submit your request.
You’ll receive a confirmation SMS/email with the estimated delivery time.

## 2. Through NetBanking

Log in to ZX Bank NetBanking.

Go to Services > Cheque Book Request.

Select your account and number of leaves required.

Verify your address and submit the request.

Track status online under Request History.

## 3. At Branch

Visit your nearest ZX Bank branch.

Fill out the Cheque Book Request Form at the counter.

Submit it to the bank officer along with valid ID, if required.

Collect acknowledgment receipt with expected dispatch date.

## 4. Via ZX Bank ATM

Insert your ZX Bank debit card and enter your PIN.

Go to Services > Cheque Book Request.

Select account and number of leaves.

Confirm the request to complete the process.

## 5. ZX Bank Customer Care

Call ZX Bank’s 24x7 helpline: 1800-XXX-XXXX (toll-free in India)

Verify your details with the customer care executive.

Place your cheque book request and note down the reference number.

### ℹ️ Frequently Asked Questions

Delivery Time: Cheque books are dispatched within 3–7 working days.

Charges: The first cheque book of the year is usually free. Subsequent requests may incur standard charges.

Track Status: Use the mobile app or NetBanking to check dispatch and delivery status.

Change Address: Update your address before placing the request to ensure correct delivery.

For more assistance, visit www.zxbank.asia or contact your nearest ZX Bank branch.

title: Health Insurance
text:
# Health Insurance

Health insurance is a type of insurance coverage that pays for medical and surgical expenses incurred by the insured. It is designed to protect individuals and families from high healthcare costs and offer access to quality medical services.

## Key Features

Coverage for Medical Expenses: Includes hospitalization, surgeries, outpatient care, prescription drugs, diagnostics, and preventive services.

Cashless Treatment: Many insurers offer cashless claim settlement at network hospitals, eliminating upfront payments by the policyholder.

Pre- and Post-Hospitalization: Expenses incurred before and after hospitalization are often covered.

Family Floater Plans: A single policy that covers the entire family under one sum insured.

Optional Add-ons: Critical illness cover, maternity benefits, accidental benefits, and top-ups for enhanced protection.

## Types of Health Insurance

Individual Health Insurance: Covers a single person.

Family Floater Health Insurance: Covers the entire family under one policy.

Senior Citizen Health Insurance: Customized for individuals above a certain age (typically 60+).

Critical Illness Insurance: Lump sum payout on diagnosis of specific illnesses like cancer, heart attack, etc.

Group Health Insurance: Provided by employers for their employees.

## Benefits

Financial Protection: Shields against expensive medical treatments.

Access to Quality Healthcare: Facilitates timely and quality healthcare services.

Tax Benefits: Premiums paid are eligible for tax deductions (e.g., under Section 80D in India).

Peace of Mind: Reduces the stress of unexpected medical emergencies.

## Important Terms

## How to Choose a Health Insurance Plan

Assess Your Needs: Consider age, family size, health conditions.

Compare Plans: Look for coverage, exclusions, claim process, and premium.

Check Network Hospitals: Wide network ensures better access.

Understand Exclusions: Know what isn’t covered.

Look for Add-ons: Customize the policy for better protection.

Review Claim Settlement Ratio: Indicates reliability of insurer.

## Common Exclusions

Pre-existing diseases (during waiting period)

Cosmetic treatments

Dental and vision (unless specified)

Self-inflicted injuries

Non-allopathic treatments

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is health insurance mandatory?
A: Not in most countries, but highly recommended due to rising healthcare costs.

Q: What happens if a claim is denied?
A: Review the reason, appeal to the insurer, or approach a regulatory authority.

Q: Can I port my health policy to another insurer?
A: Yes, most countries allow portability after certain conditions are met.

## Useful Resources

IRDAI (India’s Insurance Regulator)

World Health Organization – Health Financing

National Health Portal, India

# How to Open a Locker at ZX Bank Branch

Opening a locker (safe deposit box) at a ZX Bank branch is a secure way to safeguard your valuables and important documents. Follow these simple steps to apply for and access a locker at any of our branches across India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, or Nepal.

## Step 1: Check Locker Availability

Visit your nearest ZX Bank branch or call the branch directly.

Inquire about locker sizes and availability.

Popular sizes: Small, Medium, Large (availability may vary by location).

## Step 2: Eligibility Criteria

Existing ZX Bank customer: You must have (or open) a savings or current account.

KYC Compliance: Ensure your KYC (Know Your Customer) details are updated.

Valid photo ID (Aadhaar/Passport/Driving License)

Address proof

Recent passport-sized photo

## Step 3: Locker Application Process

Visit the Branch: Bring original documents and photocopies.

Fill Application Form: Request and complete the ‘Locker Facility Application Form’ at the branch.

Submit KYC Documents: Attach required KYC documents to your application.

Locker Agreement: Read and sign the Locker Hirer Agreement provided by the bank.

## Step 4: Security Deposit & Rent Payment

Pay the refundable security deposit (locker rent may vary by size and city).

Locker rent is typically paid annually.

Payment can be made via cash, cheque, or direct bank transfer.

## Step 5: Locker Allotment & Access

Upon approval, a locker number will be allotted.

Receive the locker keys (usually two keys; bank does not keep duplicates).

The bank officer will guide you on locker location and operating procedure.

## Step 6: Operating the Locker

Locker can be operated during branch working hours.

Visit the branch with your locker keys and valid ID proof.

Sign the Locker Access Register each time you access the locker.

All locker operations are conducted in privacy in the vault area.

## Additional Guidelines

Nomination: Highly recommended to nominate a beneficiary for your locker.

Joint Locker: You can opt for a joint locker with another account holder.

Loss of Key: Inform the bank immediately; charges apply for key duplication/drilling.

Annual Rent: Pay annual rent on time to avoid late fees or locker freeze.

## For Assistance

Visit: Nearest ZX Bank branch

Website: www.zxbank.asia

Secure your valuables with peace of mind at ZX Bank!

# ZX Bank – Safety Features Against Online Threats

At ZX Bank, the security of your digital banking experience is our top priority. Here’s how we protect you from online threats:

## 1. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

Biometric Login: Secure access via fingerprint or facial recognition on the ZX Bank Asia app.

OTP Verification: Transactions require a One-Time Password (OTP) sent to your registered mobile/email.

Device Registration: New device logins trigger verification steps.

## 2. AI-driven Fraud Detection

Real-Time Monitoring: AI systems monitor for suspicious activities and flag unusual account behavior instantly.

Fraud Alerts: Customers receive immediate alerts for any unauthorized or suspicious transaction attempts.

## 3. End-to-End Encryption

Encrypted Transactions: All communications and financial transactions are secured with industry-standard 256-bit SSL/TLS encryption.

Secure Storage: Sensitive customer data is encrypted both in transit and at rest.

## 4. Session Timeout & Auto-Logout

Automatic Logout: User sessions automatically expire after periods of inactivity to prevent unauthorized access.

Timeout Alerts: Prompt warnings before app or online session expiry.

## 5. Secure Fund Transfer Controls

Transaction Limits: Daily/transaction limits for transfers, especially for new payees or high-risk transactions.

Beneficiary Verification: Adding new beneficiaries requires additional authentication.

## 6. Regular Security Updates

App Patching: Frequent updates to the ZX Bank Asia mobile app patch vulnerabilities and enhance defenses.

Phishing Protection: Built-in app features detect phishing links and sites, alerting users to potential threats.

## 7. User Education

Financial Literacy Campaigns: Regular alerts and campaigns educating customers on safe banking practices (how to recognize scams, avoid phishing, etc.).

24/7 Support: Dedicated helpline and in-app AI assistant “Zia” for instant security advice.

## 8. Transaction Notifications

Instant Alerts: SMS, email, and push notifications for every transaction and change to account settings.

## 9. Secure Remittance Corridors

Vetted Partners: Cross-border services only with verified financial partners.

Blockchain-based Authentication: For select regional remittances to prevent tampering and improve transparency.

Your security is our mission: Stay vigilant, never share your passwords or OTPs, and contact ZX Bank support if you notice any suspicious activity.

title: Safety Practices to Protect Yourself
text:
# Safety Practices to Protect Yourself from Online Threats

Staying safe online is crucial to protect your personal data, finances, and digital identity. Here are essential safety practices (“parasites” can be corrected as “practices”) to follow:

## 1. Use Strong, Unique Passwords

Create complex passwords using a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols.

Avoid using the same password for multiple sites.

Use a trusted password manager to store your credentials.

## 2. Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)

Add an extra layer of security with 2FA on all important accounts (email, banking, social media).

## 3. Beware of Phishing Scams

Don’t click on suspicious links or download attachments from unknown sources.

Double-check email addresses and URLs for authenticity.

Never share personal information over email or phone unless you initiated contact.

## 4. Keep Software Up to Date

Regularly update your operating system, apps, browsers, and antivirus programs to patch vulnerabilities.

## 5. Secure Your Devices

Use a screen lock (PIN, password, or fingerprint) on smartphones and computers.

Install trusted antivirus and anti-malware software.

## 6. Use Secure Connections

Avoid public Wi-Fi for sensitive transactions; use a VPN when needed.

Only enter personal or financial information on websites with HTTPS.

## 7. Monitor Bank and Credit Accounts

Review statements regularly for unauthorized transactions.

Set up instant alerts for account activity.

## 8. Manage Privacy Settings

Limit what information you share on social media and adjust privacy controls.

Be wary of apps requesting unnecessary permissions.

## 9. Backup Important Data

Regularly backup your files to a secure cloud service or external device.

## 10. Educate Yourself & Stay Informed

Learn about new and emerging online threats.

Participate in cybersecurity awareness programs.

Stay alert and proactive. Safe online habits protect your identity, money, and peace of mind!

# How to Convert Your Salary Account to a Savings Account at ZX Bank

If your employment has changed, or your salary account is no longer receiving regular salary credits, you may need to convert your Salary Account to a regular Savings Account. At ZX Bank, this process is straightforward. Here’s how you can do it:

## Why Convert Your Salary Account?

Salary accounts are typically provided to employees for salary credits and have special benefits.

If salary credits stop (for 3+ months), your account may be automatically converted to a Savings Account by the bank, but manual conversion avoids service interruptions.

Savings accounts have different features and requirements, including minimum balance criteria.

## Steps to Convert Salary Account to Savings Account

### 1. Visit Your Home Branch

Locate your nearest ZX Bank branch (especially the one where you opened your salary account).

Carry valid proof of identity (Aadhaar, PAN Card, Passport, etc.) and account passbook/debit card.

### 2. Fill Out the Account Conversion Request Form

Request a Salary to Savings Account Conversion Form at the branch.

Fill in your details, mention your account number, and select “Convert to Savings Account.”

Attach self-attested copies of requested KYC documents (if required).

### 3. Submit the Form and Documents

Hand over the filled form and documents to the branch staff.

The staff will verify your documents and initiate the conversion process.

### 4. Maintain Minimum Balance

Ensure you maintain the required minimum balance for Savings Accounts as per ZX Bank guidelines, to avoid charges.

### 5. Get Confirmation

You will receive confirmation via SMS/email once the conversion is complete.

Existing debit card, chequebook, and account number typically remain unchanged.

## Alternative: Conversion via Digital Banking

ZX Bank also enables digital requests:

Open the ZX Bank Asia Mobile App or log into NetBanking.

Go to “Service Requests” > “Convert Salary Account to Savings Account.”

Fill in details and upload necessary KYC docs, if asked.

Receive confirmation after processing.

## Need Help?

Call Customer Care: ZX Bank Contact

Visit your Branch: Find locations here

Use Zia, the AI Chatbot: Available in the ZX Bank Asia app for instant assistance

Note: If the account is not converted and continues to have no salary credits, ZX Bank may automatically convert it to a savings account after a stipulated period as per bank policy.

# How to Convert Your ZX Bank Savings Account to a Salary Account

If you’re joining a new company, or your employer has partnered with ZX Bank for salary disbursement, you may want to convert your existing savings account into a salary account for added benefits. This guide walks you through the process with ZX Bank.

## Why Convert to a Salary Account?

Zero minimum balance requirement (in most salary account types)

Faster salary credit and alerts

Preferential offers on loans, credit cards, and more

Fee waivers on select services

Exclusive benefits like insurance and accidental coverage

## Steps to Convert Savings Account to Salary Account at ZX Bank

### 1. Check Your Employer’s Tie-Up

Confirm with your HR/Payroll department if they have a salary account arrangement with ZX Bank.

Obtain the official employer letter or introduction.

### 2. Visit Your Home Branch or Use ZX Bank Asia App

You can initiate the conversion:

By visiting your ZX Bank home branch, OR

Through the “Account Services” section in the ZX Bank Asia app

### 3. Provide Required Documents

Prepare the following documents: - Copy of your employee ID card - Letter from employer (on company letterhead) specifying: - Employment status and salary account introduction - Account number (if upgrade of an existing account) - PAN card (if not already updated in records) - Recent passport-size photograph (if required) - KYC update if asked by bank staff

### 4. Fill Out Conversion Form

At the branch: Ask for the Account Conversion/Upgrade Form and fill in the details.

On app: Navigate to ☰ > Account Services > Convert to Salary Account and follow on-screen prompts. Upload scanned documents if prompted.

### 5. Verification and Processing

The bank will verify documents.

Upon successful verification, your account type will change to Salary Account.

Obtain written/email confirmation from the bank.

### 6. Enjoy Salary Account Benefits!

Zero minimum balance

Priority services and offers

Employer-specific benefits if applicable

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Q: Will my account number or debit card change?

A: No, your account number remains the same. Debit card change is only if you opt for exclusive salary account variants.

### Q: What if my salary is not credited for a few months?

A: If salary is not credited for 3-6 months (as per bank policy), the account may revert to a regular savings account with applicable minimum balance criteria.

### Q: Can I convert online?

For more assistance, contact the nearest ZX Bank branch or call customer care via the ZX Bank Asia app.

text:
# ZX Bank Asia Mobile App Guide

## Overview

The ZX Bank Asia mobile app is your gateway to seamless, secure, and smart banking. With support for Android and iOS, manage your finances on the go with intuitive banking features, advanced security, and real-time assistance.

## 1. How to Download the ZX Bank Asia App

For Android: 1. Open Google Play Store. 2. Search for: ZX Bank Asia. 3. Tap Download and install the app.

For iOS: 1. Open Apple App Store. 2. Search for: ZX Bank Asia. 3. Tap Get and install the app.

## 2. How to Activate Mobile Banking

Open the ZX Bank Asia App.

Tap on Register / Activate.

Enter your registered mobile number & customer ID/account number.

Authenticate via OTP sent to your mobile.

Set your preferred login PIN or configure biometric authentication (fingerprint/Face ID).

Complete e-KYC verification if prompted.

## 3. How to Login

Open the app.

Enter your PIN or use biometric login (if enabled).

Access your dashboard securely.

## 4. App Features

### Account Management

Check savings/current account balances.

View transaction history and mini statements.

Track FD, RD, and loan details in real-time.

### Fund Transfer

#### Within ZX Bank / Other Banks

Tap Fund Transfer.

Choose between ZX Bank or Other Bank (NEFT/IMPS/UPI).

Select/Add payee (see below).

Enter amount & remarks.

Confirm with PIN/OTP.

#### Add Payee

Go to Fund Transfer → Manage Payees.

Select Add Payee.

Enter payee’s account info (name, bank details, IFSC) or UPI ID.

Verify via OTP.

Payee is added–start transferring.

### Bill Payments & QR

Pay electricity, water, gas, mobile & credit card bills.

Scan & pay using QR codes at merchants or for quick money transfers.

### Cards

#### Check, Apply & Manage Credit/Debit Cards

View existing cards with usage summary, payment due dates, statements, and reward points.

Block Card: Select card → More options → Block (immediate effect).

Reset Card PIN: Select card → Change PIN → Enter old & new PIN.

Apply New Card: Cards Menu → Apply for New Card → Choose credit or debit → Fill application & submit docs.

#### Set Card Limits

Go to Manage Cards.

Choose the card and tap Set Transaction Limit.

Adjust for ATM, POS, online, contactless—save changes.

### Loans

View all loans, EMIs, schedules & download statements.

Apply for new loans: Home, personal, or vehicle → Fill form → Upload KYC → Track status.

### Rewards

Check Rewards tab for current points.

Redeem reward points instantly for vouchers, cashback, or gift cards.

### NRI & Wealth

Access NRI services, mutual funds, wealth advisory, and initiate investments.

### Chatbot – Zia

Ask Zia for help with account queries, product info, quick balance, and transaction support.

## 5. Security Options

Biometric login (fingerprint/Face ID)

Dynamic device registration & One-Time Password (OTP) validation

Instant blocking of internet/mobile banking through the app

## 6. Other Popular Services

Request Cheque Book: Accounts → Services → Request Cheque Book

Update Contact Details: Profile → Edit → Authenticate with OTP

Mini Statements: Account → View Mini Statement

Locate Branch/ATM: Find ZX Bank locations in all supported countries

Notifications: Get real-time alerts for all transactions and offers

## 7. Customer Support

Use in-app chat or helpline.

Email or schedule branch appointments via the app.

Download & start banking smarter with the ZX Bank Asia App!

title: ZX Bank Credit Card Help
text:
# How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card

Closing your ZX Bank Credit Card is a straightforward process. Follow the steps below to ensure a smooth and secure closure:

## 1. Clear Outstanding Dues

Pay Off All Dues: Settle any outstanding amounts (balances, fees, charges, or EMI on the card).

Download Statements: Keep a record of your final statement for future reference.

## 2. Redeem Unused Rewards

Check for Points: Redeem all reward points, cashback, or benefits, as they will be lost after closure.

## 3. Cancel Auto-debits & Linked Payments

Deactivate: Cancel standing instructions, auto-debits, or subscriptions linked to your card.

## 4. Request Card Closure

You can place a closure request using any of the following channels:

### a. Via ZX Bank Mobile App (“ZX Bank Asia”)

Login to the app.

Go to Card Services > Credit Card Closure.

Select your card and follow the on-screen prompts.

### b. Through ZX NetBanking

Login to ZX NetBanking.

Navigate to Cards > Credit Cards > Close Credit Card.

Select your credit card and confirm your request.

### c. Customer Care

Call 24x7 helpline:

India: 1800-123-4567

Sri Lanka: 011-2345678

Bangladesh: 0961-234567

Request card closure with your card details handy.

### d. Branch Visit

Visit your nearest ZX Bank branch.

Submit a written request or fill out a card closure form.

## 5. Destroy the Card

After confirmation, cut your card (including chip and magnetic strip) and dispose of it securely.

## 6. Obtain Closure Confirmation

Closure Letter/Email: ZX Bank will send a closure confirmation within 7 working days.

Check CIBIL/Credit Report: Ensure the card appears as ‘closed’ (not ‘settled’).

## #### Important Notes

Closing a credit card may affect your credit score.

You cannot re-activate a closed card; a new application is required.

If you see continuing charges post-closure, inform ZX Bank immediately.

For help, contact ZX Bank Customer Care via the ZX Bank Asia mobile app or visit www.zxbank.asia.

Register Online:
Enable auto debit for your chosen billers via Mobile App or
NetBanking.
Custom Schedule:

Automated Payments:
ZX Bank automatically processes payments on your behalf.
Alerts & Notifications:

title: Fraud Transaction
text:
How to Report a
Fraud Transaction at ZX Bank
If you suspect or identify a fraudulent transaction on your ZX Bank
account, follow these steps immediately to secure your funds and resolve
the issue.
Step 1: Contact ZX Bank
Immediately
Hotline (24x7):
India: 1800 123 9876
Sri Lanka: +94 11 2345678
Bangladesh: +880 9612 345678
Bhutan: +975 2 345678
Nepal: +977 1 2345678
Email:
fraudreport@zxbank.asia
Mobile App:
Go to
ZX Bank Asia
app
→ Support → Report Fraud
Step 2: Block
Your Card or Account (If Applicable)
Via Mobile App or NetBanking:
Go to “Card Management” or “Account Services”
Select “Block/Card Hotlisting” or “Freeze Account”
Confirm the action
Step 3: Gather Key
Information
When reporting, be ready with the following: - Your account
number/User ID - Date and time of the suspicious transaction -
Transaction amount and details - Any SMS/email alerts received -
Screenshots or documentation (if available)
Step 4: File a Written
Complaint
In Branch:
Visit your nearest ZX Bank branch and
submit a written complaint.
Online:
Use NetBanking > Service Requests > Dispute Transaction
Email a formal complaint to fraudreport@zxbank.asia
Step 5: Follow Up & Track
Resolution
ZX Bank will provide a reference number for your complaint.
You can track progress via the app (Support > Track Requests) or
by calling the hotline.
ZX Bank targets resolution within 10 working days.
Extra Tips
Never share PIN, OTP, or passwords with
anyone.
Activate transaction alerts via SMS and Email.
Regularly review your account statements.
For urgent blocking, use the “Block Instantly” option in the
app.
Your safety is our priority. Report suspicious activities as
soon as possible to minimize risk.

title: Health Insurance
text:
Health Insurance
Health insurance is a type of insurance coverage that pays for
medical and surgical expenses incurred by the insured. It is designed to
protect individuals and families from high healthcare costs and offer
access to quality medical services.
Key Features
Coverage for Medical Expenses:
Includes
hospitalization, surgeries, outpatient care, prescription drugs,
diagnostics, and preventive services.
Cashless Treatment:
Many insurers offer cashless
claim settlement at network hospitals, eliminating upfront payments by
the policyholder.
Pre- and Post-Hospitalization:
Expenses incurred
before and after hospitalization are often covered.
Family Floater Plans:
A single policy that covers
the entire family under one sum insured.
Optional Add-ons:
Critical illness cover, maternity
benefits, accidental benefits, and top-ups for enhanced protection.
Types of Health Insurance
Individual Health Insurance:
Covers a single
person.
Family Floater Health Insurance:
Covers the entire
family under one policy.
Senior Citizen Health Insurance:
Customized for
individuals above a certain age (typically 60+).
Critical Illness Insurance:
Lump sum payout on
diagnosis of specific illnesses like cancer, heart attack, etc.
Group Health Insurance:
Provided by employers for
their employees.
Benefits
Financial Protection:
Shields against expensive
medical treatments.
Access to Quality Healthcare:
Facilitates timely
and quality healthcare services.
Tax Benefits:
Premiums paid are eligible for tax
deductions (e.g., under Section 80D in India).
Peace of Mind:
Reduces the stress of unexpected
medical emergencies.
Important Terms
Term
Description
Premium
Amount paid periodically for the policy
Sum Insured
Maximum amount insurance will cover
Pre-existing Diseases
Illnesses already present before buying
Waiting Period
Tenure before certain benefits activate
Co-payment
Part of claim paid by the insured
Network Hospitals
Hospitals with direct cashless tie-ups
How to Choose a Health
Insurance Plan
Assess Your Needs:
Consider age, family size,
health conditions.
Compare Plans:
Look for coverage, exclusions, claim
process, and premium.
Check Network Hospitals:
Wide network ensures
better access.
Understand Exclusions:
Know what isn’t
covered.
Look for Add-ons:
Customize the policy for better
protection.
Review Claim Settlement Ratio:
Indicates
reliability of insurer.
Common Exclusions
Pre-existing diseases (during waiting period)
Cosmetic treatments
Dental and vision (unless specified)
Self-inflicted injuries
Non-allopathic treatments
Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Is health insurance mandatory?
A: Not in most countries, but highly recommended due to rising
healthcare costs.
Q: What happens if a claim is denied?
A: Review the reason, appeal to the insurer, or approach a regulatory
authority.
Q: Can I port my health policy to another
insurer?
A: Yes, most countries allow portability after certain conditions are
met.
Useful Resources
IRDAI (India’s Insurance
Regulator)
World
Health Organization – Health Financing
National Health Portal,
India

individuals and businesses to manage accounts, perform transactions, pay
bills, and access banking services anytime, anywhere.

Account balance & statement viewing

title: Open a Locker
text:
How to Open a Locker at
ZX Bank Branch
Opening a locker (safe deposit box) at a ZX Bank branch is a secure
way to safeguard your valuables and important documents. Follow these
simple steps to apply for and access a locker at any of our branches
across India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, or Nepal.
Step 1: Check Locker
Availability
Visit your nearest
ZX Bank branch
or call the
branch directly.
Inquire about locker sizes and availability.
Popular sizes: Small, Medium, Large (availability may vary by
location).
Step 2: Eligibility Criteria
Existing ZX Bank customer:
You must have (or open)
a savings or current account.
KYC Compliance:
Ensure your KYC (Know Your
Customer) details are updated.
Valid photo ID (Aadhaar/Passport/Driving License)
Address proof
Recent passport-sized photo
Step 3: Locker Application
Process
Visit the Branch:
Bring original documents and
photocopies.
Fill Application Form:
Request and complete the
‘Locker Facility Application Form’ at the branch.
Submit KYC Documents:
Attach required KYC documents
to your application.
Locker Agreement:
Read and sign the Locker Hirer
Agreement provided by the bank.
Step 4: Security Deposit
& Rent Payment
Pay the
refundable security deposit
(locker rent
may vary by size and city).
Locker rent is typically paid
annually
.
Payment can be made via cash, cheque, or direct bank transfer.
Step 5: Locker Allotment &
Access
Upon approval, a locker number will be allotted.
Receive the
locker keys
(usually two keys; bank
does not keep duplicates).
The bank officer will guide you on locker location and operating
procedure.
Step 6: Operating the Locker
Locker can be operated
during branch working
hours
.
Visit the branch with your locker keys and valid ID proof.
Sign the
Locker Access Register
each time you
access the locker.
All locker operations are conducted in privacy in the vault
area.
Additional Guidelines
Nomination:
Highly recommended to nominate a
beneficiary for your locker.
Joint Locker:
You can opt for a joint locker with
another account holder.
Loss of Key:
Inform the bank immediately; charges
apply for key duplication/drilling.
Annual Rent:
Pay annual rent on time to avoid late
fees or locker freeze.
For Assistance
Visit:
Nearest ZX Bank branch
Website:
www.zxbank.asia
Customer Care:
Check the contact section on the
official website or mobile app
Secure your valuables with peace of mind at ZX
Bank!

title: Safety Features
text:
ZX Bank – Safety
Features Against Online Threats
At ZX Bank, the security of your digital banking experience is our
top priority. Here’s how we protect you from online threats:
1.
Multi-Factor
Authentication (MFA)
Biometric Login:
Secure access via fingerprint or
facial recognition on the ZX Bank Asia app.
OTP Verification:
Transactions require a One-Time
Password (OTP) sent to your registered mobile/email.
Device Registration:
New device logins trigger
verification steps.
2.
AI-driven Fraud
Detection
Real-Time Monitoring:
AI systems monitor for
suspicious activities and flag unusual account behavior instantly.
Fraud Alerts:
Customers receive immediate alerts
for any unauthorized or suspicious transaction attempts.
3.
End-to-End
Encryption
Encrypted Transactions:
All communications and
financial transactions are secured with industry-standard 256-bit
SSL/TLS encryption.
Secure Storage:
Sensitive customer data is
encrypted both in transit and at rest.
4.
Session Timeout &
Auto-Logout
Automatic Logout:
User sessions automatically
expire after periods of inactivity to prevent unauthorized access.
Timeout Alerts:
Prompt warnings before app or
online session expiry.
5.
Secure Fund Transfer
Controls
Transaction Limits:
Daily/transaction limits for
transfers, especially for new payees or high-risk transactions.
Beneficiary Verification:
Adding new beneficiaries
requires additional authentication.
6.
Regular Security
Updates
App Patching:
Frequent updates to the ZX Bank Asia
mobile app patch vulnerabilities and enhance defenses.
Phishing Protection:
Built-in app features detect
phishing links and sites, alerting users to potential threats.
7.
User Education
Financial Literacy Campaigns:
Regular alerts and
campaigns educating customers on safe banking practices (how to
recognize scams, avoid phishing, etc.).
24/7 Support:
Dedicated helpline and in-app AI
assistant “Zia” for instant security advice.
8.
Transaction
Notifications
Instant Alerts:
SMS, email, and push notifications
for every transaction and change to account settings.
9.
Secure Remittance
Corridors
Vetted Partners:
Cross-border services only with
verified financial partners.
Blockchain-based Authentication:
For select
regional remittances to prevent tampering and improve transparency.
Your security is our mission:
Stay vigilant, never
share your passwords or OTPs, and contact ZX Bank support if you notice
any suspicious activity.

title: Safety Practices to Protect Yourself
text:
Safety
Practices to Protect Yourself from Online Threats
Staying safe online is crucial to protect your personal data,
finances, and digital identity. Here are essential safety practices
(“parasites” can be corrected as “practices”) to follow:
1.
Use Strong, Unique
Passwords
Create complex passwords using a mix of letters, numbers, and
symbols.
Avoid using the same password for multiple sites.
Use a trusted password manager to store your credentials.
2.
Enable
Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
Add an extra layer of security with 2FA on all important accounts
(email, banking, social media).
3.
Beware of Phishing
Scams
Don’t click on suspicious links or download attachments from unknown
sources.
Double-check email addresses and URLs for authenticity.
Never share personal information over email or phone unless you
initiated contact.
4.
Keep Software Up to
Date
Regularly update your operating system, apps, browsers, and
antivirus programs to patch vulnerabilities.
5.
Secure Your
Devices
Use a screen lock (PIN, password, or fingerprint) on smartphones and
computers.
Install trusted antivirus and anti-malware software.
6.
Use Secure
Connections
Avoid public Wi-Fi for sensitive transactions; use a VPN when
needed.
Only enter personal or financial information on websites with
HTTPS.
7.
Monitor Bank and
Credit Accounts
Review statements regularly for unauthorized transactions.
Set up instant alerts for account activity.
8.
Manage Privacy
Settings
Limit what information you share on social media and adjust privacy
controls.
Be wary of apps requesting unnecessary permissions.
9.
Backup Important
Data
Regularly backup your files to a secure cloud service or external
device.
10.
Educate Yourself
& Stay Informed
Learn about new and emerging online threats.
Participate in cybersecurity awareness programs.
Stay alert and proactive. Safe online habits protect your
identity, money, and peace of mind!

title: Salary Account to a Savings Account
text:
How
to Convert Your Salary Account to a Savings Account at ZX Bank
If your employment has changed, or your salary account is no longer
receiving regular salary credits, you may need to convert your Salary
Account to a regular Savings Account. At ZX Bank, this process is
straightforward. Here’s how you can do it:
Why Convert Your Salary
Account?
Salary accounts
are typically provided to employees
for salary credits and have special benefits.
If salary credits stop (for 3+ months), your account may be
automatically converted to a Savings Account by the bank, but manual
conversion avoids service interruptions.
Savings accounts have different features and requirements, including
minimum balance criteria.
Steps to
Convert Salary Account to Savings Account
1. Visit Your Home Branch
Locate your nearest
ZX Bank branch
(especially the
one where you opened your salary account).
Carry valid
proof of identity
(Aadhaar, PAN Card,
Passport, etc.) and
account passbook/debit card
.
2. Fill Out the
Account Conversion Request Form
Request a
Salary to Savings Account Conversion Form
at the branch.
Fill in your details, mention your account number, and select
“Convert to Savings Account.”
Attach self-attested copies of requested KYC documents (if
required).
3. Submit the Form and
Documents
Hand over the filled form and documents to the branch staff.
The staff will verify your documents and initiate the conversion
process.
4. Maintain Minimum Balance
Ensure you maintain the
required minimum balance
for Savings Accounts as per ZX Bank guidelines, to avoid charges.
5. Get Confirmation
You will receive confirmation via SMS/email once the conversion is
complete.
Existing debit card, chequebook, and account number typically remain
unchanged.
Alternative:
Conversion via Digital Banking
ZX Bank also enables digital requests:
Open the ZX Bank Asia Mobile App
or log into
NetBanking.
Go to “Service Requests” > “Convert Salary Account to Savings
Account.”
Fill in details and upload necessary KYC docs, if asked.
Receive confirmation after processing.
Need Help?
Call Customer Care:
ZX Bank Contact
Visit your Branch:
Find locations
here
Use Zia, the AI Chatbot:
Available in the ZX Bank
Asia app for instant assistance
Note:
If the account is not converted and continues
to have no salary credits, ZX Bank may automatically convert it to a
savings account after a stipulated period as per bank policy.
ZX Bank Ltd. | Your trusted banking partner in South
Asia

title: Savings Account to a Salary Account
text:
How
to Convert Your ZX Bank Savings Account to a Salary Account
If you’re joining a new company, or your employer has partnered with
ZX Bank for salary disbursement, you may want to convert your existing
savings account into a salary account for added benefits. This guide
walks you through the process with ZX Bank.
Why Convert to a Salary
Account?
Zero minimum balance
requirement (in most salary
account types)
Faster salary credit
and alerts
Preferential offers
on loans, credit cards, and
more
Fee waivers
on select services
Exclusive benefits
like insurance and accidental
coverage
Steps
to Convert Savings Account to Salary Account at ZX Bank
1. Check Your Employer’s
Tie-Up
Confirm with your HR/Payroll department if they have a salary
account arrangement with ZX Bank.
Obtain the official employer letter or introduction.
2. Visit Your
Home Branch or Use ZX Bank Asia App
You can initiate the conversion:
By visiting your ZX Bank home branch,
OR
Through the “Account Services” section in the
ZX Bank
Asia
app
3. Provide Required Documents
Prepare the following documents: - Copy of your
employee ID
card
-
Letter from employer
(on company
letterhead) specifying: - Employment status and salary account
introduction - Account number (if upgrade of an existing account) -
PAN card
(if not already updated in records) -
Recent passport-size photograph
(if required) -
KYC update
if asked by bank staff
4. Fill Out Conversion Form
At the branch: Ask for the
Account Conversion/Upgrade
Form
and fill in the details.
On app: Navigate to ☰ > Account Services > Convert to Salary
Account and follow on-screen prompts. Upload scanned documents if
prompted.
5. Verification and Processing
The bank will verify documents.
Upon successful verification, your account type will change to
Salary Account
.
Obtain written/email confirmation from the bank.
6. Enjoy Salary Account
Benefits!
Zero minimum balance
Priority services and offers
Employer-specific benefits if applicable
Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Will my
account number or debit card change?
A:
No, your account number remains the same. Debit
card change is only if you opt for exclusive salary account
variants.
Q: What if
my salary is not credited for a few months?
A:
If salary is not credited for 3-6 months (as per
bank policy), the account may revert to a regular savings account with
applicable minimum balance criteria.
Q: Can I convert online?
A:
Yes, if your employer is registered with ZX Bank
and your KYC is up to date, you can use the ZX Bank Asia app or
NetBanking for conversion.
For more assistance, contact the nearest ZX Bank branch or call
customer care via the ZX Bank Asia app.
🔗
Visit ZX Bank Website

mobile app is your gateway to

. 3. Tap

.

.

.
Adjust for ATM, POS, online, contactless—save changes.

title: ZX Bank Credit Card Help
text:
How to Close Your ZX Bank
Credit Card
Closing your ZX Bank Credit Card is a straightforward process. Follow
the steps below to ensure a smooth and secure closure:
1.
Clear Outstanding
Dues
Pay Off All Dues:
Settle any outstanding amounts
(balances, fees, charges, or EMI on the card).
Download Statements:
Keep a record of your final
statement for future reference.
2.
Redeem Unused
Rewards
Check for Points:
Redeem all reward points,
cashback, or benefits, as they will be lost after closure.
3.
Cancel
Auto-debits & Linked Payments
Deactivate:
Cancel standing instructions,
auto-debits, or subscriptions linked to your card.
4.
Request Card
Closure
You can place a closure request using any of the following
channels:
a.
Via ZX Bank
Mobile App (“ZX Bank Asia”)
Login to the app.
Go to
Card Services
>
Credit Card
Closure
.
Select your card and follow the on-screen prompts.
b.
Through ZX
NetBanking
Login to ZX NetBanking.
Navigate to
Cards
>
Credit
Cards
>
Close Credit Card
.
Select your credit card and confirm your request.
c.
Customer Care
Call 24x7 helpline:
India: 1800-123-4567
Sri Lanka: 011-2345678
Bangladesh: 0961-234567
Request card closure with your card details handy.
d.
Branch Visit
Visit your nearest ZX Bank branch.
Submit a written request or fill out a card closure form.
5.
Destroy the Card
After confirmation,
cut your card (including chip
and magnetic strip) and dispose of it securely.
6.
Obtain Closure
Confirmation
Closure Letter/Email:
ZX Bank will send a closure
confirmation within 7 working days.
Check CIBIL/Credit Report:
Ensure the card appears
as ‘closed’ (not ‘settled’).
#### Important Notes
Closing a credit card may affect your credit score.
You cannot re-activate a closed card; a new application is
required.
If you see continuing charges post-closure, inform ZX Bank
immediately.
For help, contact ZX Bank Customer Care via the
ZX Bank
Asia
mobile app or visit
www.zxbank.asia
.

title: (UPI) – ZX Bank Asia
text:
# Unified Payments Interface (UPI) – ZX Bank Asia

Unified Payments Interface (UPI) is a real-time payment system that enables instant money transfer between bank accounts using your mobile device. ZX Bank Asia supports UPI seamlessly through its mobile app for fast, secure, and convenient transactions.

---

## 💡 What is UPI?
- **Instant, 24x7 money transfers** via mobile devices  
- **Single app** for accessing multiple bank accounts  
- **Easy transactions** using mobile number, Virtual Payment Address (VPA), or QR codes  
- **Used for:** Fund transfer, bill payments, merchant payments, and more

---

## 📱 How to Activate UPI with ZX Bank

1. **Download the ZX Bank Asia App**  
   - Available for: [Android](#) and [iOS](#)

2. **Login/Register**  
   - Use mobile number registered with ZX Bank  
   - Complete e-KYC if not already done

3. **Go to UPI Section**  
   - Tap 'UPI' icon or navigate via home screen

4. **Create or Link UPI ID (VPA)**
   - Example: `yourname@zxbank`
   - Choose/set your UPI PIN for secure transactions

5. **Link Your ZX Bank Account**
   - Select the account to operate UPI with

6. **Set/Reset UPI PIN**
   - Authenticate with debit card details
   - Set a 4/6-digit UPI PIN

7. **Ready to Use**
   - Start transacting, paying bills, transferring funds, and scanning UPI QR codes 

---

## 🏦 UPI Daily Limits with ZX Bank

| Transaction Type         | Limit                                                |
|------------------------- |-----------------------------------------------------|
| **Per Transaction**      | ₹1,00,000*                                          |
| **Per Day (total)**      | ₹1,00,000* across all UPI transactions              |
| **Max Transactions/Day** | 20 transfers**                                      |

> \*Limits as per NPCI & ZX Bank policies. Subject to change.   
> \*\*May vary based on customer risk profile and regulatory updates.

---

## 🛠️ UPI Customer Support

- **In-App:** Use 'Help & Support' section in ZX Bank Asia App > UPI  
- **Call:** ZX Bank Customer Care: 1800-XXX-XXXX (toll-free in India)  
- **Email:** upi.support@zxbank.asia  
- **Chat:** Ask "Zia" – ZX Bank's AI assistant – in the app for UPI help

---

**Note:**  
- UPI services currently available in India for ZX Bank account holders  
- For cross-border payments/remittances, use dedicated remittance options in the app

---

# How to Apply for a Cheque Book at ZX Bank

Applying for a cheque book from ZX Bank is simple and can be done through multiple convenient channels. Follow the steps below to request your new cheque book.

3. **Select:** Tap on **Cheque Book Request**.
4. **Choose Account:** Select the account for which you need the cheque book.
5. **Confirm Details:** Enter delivery address (if different from registered address).

3. Select your account and number of leaves required.
4. Verify your address and submit the request.
5. Track status online under **Request History**.

1. Visit your nearest **ZX Bank branch**.
2. Fill out the **Cheque Book Request Form** at the counter.
3. Submit it to the bank officer along with valid ID, if required.
4. Collect acknowledgment receipt with expected dispatch date.

title: Bill Payments
text:
# ZX Bank – Bill Payments & Auto Debit Feature

ZX Bank aims to simplify your bill management experience with its robust **Bill Payments** and **Auto Debit** features, accessible via the [ZX Bank Asia Mobile App](https://www.zxbank.asia), NetBanking, and branch network.

---

## Supported Bill Payment Categories

- **Credit Cards** (ZX Bank & other banks)
- **Mobile/Postpaid Bills**
- **Prepaid Mobile Recharge**
- **DTH (Direct-to-Home TV)**
- **Broadband & Landline**
- **Electricity, Water, & Gas**
- **Insurance Premiums**
- **Educational Fees**
- **Municipality Taxes**  
- **More coming soon!**

---

## Auto Debit Feature

**Never miss a payment!**  
Set up hassle-free auto debits from your ZX Bank account or credit card for recurring bills.

### How Auto Debit Works

1. **Register Online:**  
   Enable auto debit for your chosen billers via Mobile App or NetBanking.

2. **Custom Schedule:**  
   Select the payment date (due date or preferred day prior).

3. **Automated Payments:**  
   ZX Bank automatically processes payments on your behalf.

4. **Alerts & Notifications:**  
   Get SMS/email alerts before every scheduled auto debit.

5. **Manage & Cancel Anytime:**  
   Modify or stop auto debits anytime using the "Manage Mandates" section.

---

## Key Features

- **One-Time Setup:** Easy linking of billers and mandates
- **Secure Payments:** Protected with OTP, biometric & device authentication
- **All Major Billers Covered:** Over 400+ billers across India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal
- **Real-Time Tracking:** View payment history and upcoming debits
- **AI Financial Assistant (“Zia”):** Get reminders, advice, and instant support

---

## How To Get Started

1. **Download the ZX Bank Asia Mobile App** (*Android/iOS*)
2. **Login** or complete e-KYC onboarding
3. **Navigate to “Bill Payments” or “Auto Debit”**  
   - Add your biller (credit card, mobile, DTH, etc.)
   - Choose “Enable Auto Debit” and set your preferences
4. **Confirm & Save** — you're done!

---

### Need Help?
- Ask “Zia” in-app for step-by-step guidance
- Visit [www.zxbank.asia/support](https://www.zxbank.asia/support)
- Call our 24x7 helpline or visit your nearest branch

---

*Experience seamless bill payments – simplify your financial life with ZX Bank!*

title: Cross-Border Payments
text:
# Fast Cross-Border Payments with ZX Bank

### Seamless Transfers Across South Asia

ZX Bank provides **fast, secure cross-border payment services** between **India, Sri Lanka, Nepal, and Bhutan**. Whether you’re sending money home, paying for business imports, or supporting family across the region, ZX Bank guarantees a seamless remittance experience.

---

## Key Features

- **Instant Transfers:** Most transfers are processed within minutes using ZX Bank’s advanced payment rails and SWIFT capabilities.
- **Transparent Fees:** Competitive, upfront charges with no hidden costs.

title: Health Insurance
text:
# Health Insurance

Health insurance is a type of insurance coverage that pays for medical and surgical expenses incurred by the insured. It is designed to protect individuals and families from high healthcare costs and offer access to quality medical services.

## Key Features

- **Coverage for Medical Expenses:** Includes hospitalization, surgeries, outpatient care, prescription drugs, diagnostics, and preventive services.
- **Cashless Treatment:** Many insurers offer cashless claim settlement at network hospitals, eliminating upfront payments by the policyholder.
- **Pre- and Post-Hospitalization:** Expenses incurred before and after hospitalization are often covered.
- **Family Floater Plans:** A single policy that covers the entire family under one sum insured.
- **Optional Add-ons:** Critical illness cover, maternity benefits, accidental benefits, and top-ups for enhanced protection.

## Types of Health Insurance

- **Individual Health Insurance:** Covers a single person.
- **Family Floater Health Insurance:** Covers the entire family under one policy.
- **Senior Citizen Health Insurance:** Customized for individuals above a certain age (typically 60+).
- **Critical Illness Insurance:** Lump sum payout on diagnosis of specific illnesses like cancer, heart attack, etc.
- **Group Health Insurance:** Provided by employers for their employees.

## Benefits

- **Financial Protection:** Shields against expensive medical treatments.
- **Access to Quality Healthcare:** Facilitates timely and quality healthcare services.
- **Tax Benefits:** Premiums paid are eligible for tax deductions (e.g., under Section 80D in India).
- **Peace of Mind:** Reduces the stress of unexpected medical emergencies.

## Important Terms

| Term                      | Description                                |
|---------------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| **Premium**               | Amount paid periodically for the policy    |
| **Sum Insured**           | Maximum amount insurance will cover        |
| **Pre-existing Diseases** | Illnesses already present before buying    |
| **Waiting Period**        | Tenure before certain benefits activate    |
| **Co-payment**            | Part of claim paid by the insured          |
| **Network Hospitals**     | Hospitals with direct cashless tie-ups     |

## How to Choose a Health Insurance Plan

1. **Assess Your Needs:** Consider age, family size, health conditions.
2. **Compare Plans:** Look for coverage, exclusions, claim process, and premium.
3. **Check Network Hospitals:** Wide network ensures better access.
4. **Understand Exclusions:** Know what isn’t covered.
5. **Look for Add-ons:** Customize the policy for better protection.
6. **Review Claim Settlement Ratio:** Indicates reliability of insurer.

## Common Exclusions

- Pre-existing diseases (during waiting period)
- Cosmetic treatments
- Dental and vision (unless specified)
- Self-inflicted injuries
- Non-allopathic treatments

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is health insurance mandatory?**  
A: Not in most countries, but highly recommended due to rising healthcare costs.

**Q: What happens if a claim is denied?**  
A: Review the reason, appeal to the insurer, or approach a regulatory authority.

**Q: Can I port my health policy to another insurer?**  
A: Yes, most countries allow portability after certain conditions are met.

---

## Useful Resources

- [IRDAI (India’s Insurance Regulator)](https://www.irdai.gov.in)
- [World Health Organization – Health Financing](https://www.who.int/health-topics/health-financing)
- [National Health Portal, India](https://www.nhp.gov.in/)

title: Open a Locker
text:
# How to Open a Locker at ZX Bank Branch

Opening a locker (safe deposit box) at a ZX Bank branch is a secure way to safeguard your valuables and important documents. Follow these simple steps to apply for and access a locker at any of our branches across India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, or Nepal.

---

## Step 1: Check Locker Availability

- Visit your nearest **ZX Bank branch** or call the branch directly.
- Inquire about locker sizes and availability.
- Popular sizes: Small, Medium, Large (availability may vary by location).

---

## Step 2: Eligibility Criteria

- **Existing ZX Bank customer:** You must have (or open) a savings or current account.
- **KYC Compliance:** Ensure your KYC (Know Your Customer) details are updated.
    - Valid photo ID (Aadhaar/Passport/Driving License)
    - Address proof
    - Recent passport-sized photo

---

## Step 3: Locker Application Process

1. **Visit the Branch:** Bring original documents and photocopies.
2. **Fill Application Form:** Request and complete the ‘Locker Facility Application Form’ at the branch.
3. **Submit KYC Documents:** Attach required KYC documents to your application.
4. **Locker Agreement:** Read and sign the Locker Hirer Agreement provided by the bank.

---

## Step 4: Security Deposit & Rent Payment

- Pay the **refundable security deposit** (locker rent may vary by size and city).
- Locker rent is typically paid **annually**.
- Payment can be made via cash, cheque, or direct bank transfer.

---

## Step 5: Locker Allotment & Access

- Upon approval, a locker number will be allotted.
- Receive the **locker keys** (usually two keys; bank does not keep duplicates).
- The bank officer will guide you on locker location and operating procedure.

---

## Step 6: Operating the Locker

- Locker can be operated **during branch working hours**.
- Visit the branch with your locker keys and valid ID proof.
- Sign the **Locker Access Register** each time you access the locker.
- All locker operations are conducted in privacy in the vault area.

---

## Additional Guidelines

- **Nomination:** Highly recommended to nominate a beneficiary for your locker.
- **Joint Locker:** You can opt for a joint locker with another account holder.
- **Loss of Key:** Inform the bank immediately; charges apply for key duplication/drilling.
- **Annual Rent:** Pay annual rent on time to avoid late fees or locker freeze.

---

## For Assistance

- **Visit:** Nearest ZX Bank branch
- **Website:** [www.zxbank.asia](https://www.zxbank.asia)
- **Customer Care:** Check the contact section on the official website or mobile app

> **Secure your valuables with peace of mind at ZX Bank!**

Whether you manage your finances digitally or prefer in-person services, your PRM Assistant will guide and support you, making banking easier and more personalized than ever before.

title: Safety Features
text:
# ZX Bank – Safety Features Against Online Threats

At ZX Bank, the security of your digital banking experience is our top priority. Here’s how we protect you from online threats:

## 1. **Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)**
- **Biometric Login:** Secure access via fingerprint or facial recognition on the ZX Bank Asia app.
- **OTP Verification:** Transactions require a One-Time Password (OTP) sent to your registered mobile/email.
- **Device Registration:** New device logins trigger verification steps.

## 2. **AI-driven Fraud Detection**
- **Real-Time Monitoring:** AI systems monitor for suspicious activities and flag unusual account behavior instantly.
- **Fraud Alerts:** Customers receive immediate alerts for any unauthorized or suspicious transaction attempts.

## 3. **End-to-End Encryption**
- **Encrypted Transactions:** All communications and financial transactions are secured with industry-standard 256-bit SSL/TLS encryption.
- **Secure Storage:** Sensitive customer data is encrypted both in transit and at rest.

## 4. **Session Timeout & Auto-Logout**
- **Automatic Logout:** User sessions automatically expire after periods of inactivity to prevent unauthorized access.
- **Timeout Alerts:** Prompt warnings before app or online session expiry.

## 5. **Secure Fund Transfer Controls**
- **Transaction Limits:** Daily/transaction limits for transfers, especially for new payees or high-risk transactions.
- **Beneficiary Verification:** Adding new beneficiaries requires additional authentication.

## 6. **Regular Security Updates**
- **App Patching:** Frequent updates to the ZX Bank Asia mobile app patch vulnerabilities and enhance defenses.
- **Phishing Protection:** Built-in app features detect phishing links and sites, alerting users to potential threats.

## 7. **User Education**
- **Financial Literacy Campaigns:** Regular alerts and campaigns educating customers on safe banking practices (how to recognize scams, avoid phishing, etc.).
- **24/7 Support:** Dedicated helpline and in-app AI assistant "Zia" for instant security advice.

## 8. **Transaction Notifications**
- **Instant Alerts:** SMS, email, and push notifications for every transaction and change to account settings.

## 9. **Secure Remittance Corridors**
- **Vetted Partners:** Cross-border services only with verified financial partners.
- **Blockchain-based Authentication:** For select regional remittances to prevent tampering and improve transparency.

---

**Your security is our mission:**
Stay vigilant, never share your passwords or OTPs, and contact ZX Bank support if you notice any suspicious activity.

title: Safety Practices to Protect Yourself
text:
# Safety Practices to Protect Yourself from Online Threats

Staying safe online is crucial to protect your personal data, finances, and digital identity. Here are essential safety practices ("parasites" can be corrected as "practices") to follow:

---

## 1. **Use Strong, Unique Passwords**
- Create complex passwords using a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols.
- Avoid using the same password for multiple sites.
- Use a trusted password manager to store your credentials.

## 2. **Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)**
- Add an extra layer of security with 2FA on all important accounts (email, banking, social media).

## 3. **Beware of Phishing Scams**
- Don’t click on suspicious links or download attachments from unknown sources.
- Double-check email addresses and URLs for authenticity.
- Never share personal information over email or phone unless you initiated contact.

## 4. **Keep Software Up to Date**
- Regularly update your operating system, apps, browsers, and antivirus programs to patch vulnerabilities.

## 5. **Secure Your Devices**
- Use a screen lock (PIN, password, or fingerprint) on smartphones and computers.
- Install trusted antivirus and anti-malware software.

## 6. **Use Secure Connections**
- Avoid public Wi-Fi for sensitive transactions; use a VPN when needed.
- Only enter personal or financial information on websites with HTTPS.

## 7. **Monitor Bank and Credit Accounts**
- Review statements regularly for unauthorized transactions.
- Set up instant alerts for account activity.

## 8. **Manage Privacy Settings**
- Limit what information you share on social media and adjust privacy controls.
- Be wary of apps requesting unnecessary permissions.

## 9. **Backup Important Data**
- Regularly backup your files to a secure cloud service or external device.

## 10. **Educate Yourself & Stay Informed**
- Learn about new and emerging online threats.
- Participate in cybersecurity awareness programs.

---

> **Stay alert and proactive. Safe online habits protect your identity, money, and peace of mind!**

# How to Convert Your Salary Account to a Savings Account at ZX Bank

If your employment has changed, or your salary account is no longer receiving regular salary credits, you may need to convert your Salary Account to a regular Savings Account. At ZX Bank, this process is straightforward. Here’s how you can do it:

---

## Why Convert Your Salary Account?

- **Salary accounts** are typically provided to employees for salary credits and have special benefits.
- If salary credits stop (for 3+ months), your account may be automatically converted to a Savings Account by the bank, but manual conversion avoids service interruptions.
- Savings accounts have different features and requirements, including minimum balance criteria.

---

## Steps to Convert Salary Account to Savings Account

### 1. Visit Your Home Branch

- Locate your nearest **ZX Bank branch** (especially the one where you opened your salary account).
- Carry valid **proof of identity** (Aadhaar, PAN Card, Passport, etc.) and **account passbook/debit card**.

### 2. Fill Out the Account Conversion Request Form

- Request a **Salary to Savings Account Conversion Form** at the branch.
- Fill in your details, mention your account number, and select “Convert to Savings Account.”
- Attach self-attested copies of requested KYC documents (if required).

### 3. Submit the Form and Documents

- Hand over the filled form and documents to the branch staff.
- The staff will verify your documents and initiate the conversion process.

### 4. Maintain Minimum Balance

- Ensure you maintain the **required minimum balance** for Savings Accounts as per ZX Bank guidelines, to avoid charges.

### 5. Get Confirmation

- You will receive confirmation via SMS/email once the conversion is complete.
- Existing debit card, chequebook, and account number typically remain unchanged.

---

## Alternative: Conversion via Digital Banking

ZX Bank also enables digital requests:

1. **Open the ZX Bank Asia Mobile App** or log into NetBanking.
2. Go to “Service Requests” > “Convert Salary Account to Savings Account.”
3. Fill in details and upload necessary KYC docs, if asked.
4. Receive confirmation after processing.

---

## Need Help?

- **Call Customer Care:** [ZX Bank Contact](https://www.zxbank.asia/contact)
- **Visit your Branch:** Find locations [here](https://www.zxbank.asia/branches)
- **Use Zia, the AI Chatbot:** Available in the ZX Bank Asia app for instant assistance

---

> **Note:** If the account is not converted and continues to have no salary credits, ZX Bank may automatically convert it to a savings account after a stipulated period as per bank policy.

---

**ZX Bank Ltd. | Your trusted banking partner in South Asia**

text:
# How to Convert Your ZX Bank Savings Account to a Salary Account

If you're joining a new company, or your employer has partnered with ZX Bank for salary disbursement, you may want to convert your existing savings account into a salary account for added benefits. This guide walks you through the process with ZX Bank.

---

## Why Convert to a Salary Account?

- **Zero minimum balance** requirement (in most salary account types)
- **Faster salary credit** and alerts
- **Preferential offers** on loans, credit cards, and more
- **Fee waivers** on select services
- **Exclusive benefits** like insurance and accidental coverage

---

## Steps to Convert Savings Account to Salary Account at ZX Bank

### 1. Check Your Employer's Tie-Up
- Confirm with your HR/Payroll department if they have a salary account arrangement with ZX Bank.
- Obtain the official employer letter or introduction.

### 2. Visit Your Home Branch or Use ZX Bank Asia App
- You can initiate the conversion:
  - By visiting your ZX Bank home branch, **OR**
  - Through the "Account Services" section in the **ZX Bank Asia** app

### 3. Provide Required Documents

Prepare the following documents:
- Copy of your **employee ID card**
- **Letter from employer** (on company letterhead) specifying:
   - Employment status and salary account introduction
   - Account number (if upgrade of an existing account)
- **PAN card** (if not already updated in records)
- **Recent passport-size photograph** (if required)
- **KYC update** if asked by bank staff

### 4. Fill Out Conversion Form

- At the branch: Ask for the **Account Conversion/Upgrade Form** and fill in the details.
- On app: Navigate to ☰ > Account Services > Convert to Salary Account and follow on-screen prompts. Upload scanned documents if prompted.

### 5. Verification and Processing

- The bank will verify documents.
- Upon successful verification, your account type will change to **Salary Account**.
- Obtain written/email confirmation from the bank.

### 6. Enjoy Salary Account Benefits!

- Zero minimum balance
- Priority services and offers
- Employer-specific benefits if applicable

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Q: Will my account number or debit card change?
**A:** No, your account number remains the same. Debit card change is only if you opt for exclusive salary account variants.

### Q: What if my salary is not credited for a few months?
**A:** If salary is not credited for 3-6 months (as per bank policy), the account may revert to a regular savings account with applicable minimum balance criteria.

### Q: Can I convert online?
**A:** Yes, if your employer is registered with ZX Bank and your KYC is up to date, you can use the ZX Bank Asia app or NetBanking for conversion.

---

_For more assistance, contact the nearest ZX Bank branch or call customer care via the ZX Bank Asia app._

🔗 [Visit ZX Bank Website](https://www.zxbank.asia)

- Call our Agri Loan helpline: 1800-123-4567 (toll-free)

title: ZX Bank Asia Mobile App Guide
text:
# ZX Bank Asia Mobile App Guide

## Overview

The **ZX Bank Asia** mobile app is your gateway to seamless, secure, and smart banking. With support for Android and iOS, manage your finances on the go with intuitive banking features, advanced security, and real-time assistance.

---

## 1. How to Download the ZX Bank Asia App

**For Android:**
1. Open Google Play Store.
2. Search for: `ZX Bank Asia`.
3. Tap `Download` and install the app.

**For iOS:**
1. Open Apple App Store.
2. Search for: `ZX Bank Asia`.
3. Tap `Get` and install the app.

---

## 2. How to Activate Mobile Banking

1. **Open the ZX Bank Asia App**.
2. Tap on `Register / Activate`.
3. Enter your registered mobile number & customer ID/account number.
4. Authenticate via OTP sent to your mobile.
5. Set your preferred login PIN or configure biometric authentication (fingerprint/Face ID).
6. Complete e-KYC verification if prompted.

---

## 3. How to Login

- Open the app.
- Enter your PIN or use biometric login (if enabled).
- Access your dashboard securely.

---

## 4. App Features

### Account Management

- Check savings/current account balances.
- View transaction history and mini statements.
- Track FD, RD, and loan details in real-time.

### Fund Transfer

#### **Within ZX Bank / Other Banks**
1. Tap `Fund Transfer`.
2. Choose between ZX Bank or Other Bank (NEFT/IMPS/UPI).
3. Select/Add payee (see below).
4. Enter amount & remarks.
5. Confirm with PIN/OTP.

#### **Add Payee**
1. Go to `Fund Transfer` → `Manage Payees`.
2. Select `Add Payee`.
3. Enter payee's account info (name, bank details, IFSC) or UPI ID.
4. Verify via OTP.
5. Payee is added–start transferring.

### Bill Payments & QR

- Pay electricity, water, gas, mobile & credit card bills.
- Scan & pay using QR codes at merchants or for quick money transfers.

### Cards

#### **Check, Apply & Manage Credit/Debit Cards**
- View existing cards with usage summary, payment due dates, statements, and reward points.
- **Block Card**: Select card → More options → Block (immediate effect).
- **Reset Card PIN**: Select card → Change PIN → Enter old & new PIN.
- **Apply New Card**: Cards Menu → Apply for New Card → Choose credit or debit → Fill application & submit docs.

#### **Set Card Limits**
- Go to `Manage Cards`.
- Choose the card and tap `Set Transaction Limit`.
- Adjust for ATM, POS, online, contactless—save changes.

### Loans

- View all loans, EMIs, schedules & download statements.
- Apply for new loans: Home, personal, or vehicle → Fill form → Upload KYC → Track status.

### Rewards

- Check `Rewards` tab for current points.
- Redeem reward points instantly for vouchers, cashback, or gift cards.

### NRI & Wealth

- Access NRI services, mutual funds, wealth advisory, and initiate investments.

### Chatbot – **Zia**

- Ask Zia for help with account queries, product info, quick balance, and transaction support.

---

## 5. Security Options

- Biometric login (fingerprint/Face ID)
- Dynamic device registration & One-Time Password (OTP) validation
- Instant blocking of internet/mobile banking through the app

---

## 6. Other Popular Services

- **Request Cheque Book**: Accounts → Services → Request Cheque Book
- **Update Contact Details**: Profile → Edit → Authenticate with OTP
- **Mini Statements**: Account → View Mini Statement
- **Locate Branch/ATM**: Find ZX Bank locations in all supported countries
- **Notifications**: Get real-time alerts for all transactions and offers

---

## 7. Customer Support

- Use in-app chat or helpline.
- Email or schedule branch appointments via the app.

---

> **Download & start banking smarter with the [ZX Bank Asia App](https://www.zxbank.asia)!**

title: ZX Bank Credit Card Help
text:
# How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card

Closing your ZX Bank Credit Card is a straightforward process. Follow the steps below to ensure a smooth and secure closure:

---

## 1. **Clear Outstanding Dues**
- **Pay Off All Dues:** Settle any outstanding amounts (balances, fees, charges, or EMI on the card).
- **Download Statements:** Keep a record of your final statement for future reference.

---

## 2. **Redeem Unused Rewards**
- **Check for Points:** Redeem all reward points, cashback, or benefits, as they will be lost after closure.

---

## 3. **Cancel Auto-debits & Linked Payments**
- **Deactivate:** Cancel standing instructions, auto-debits, or subscriptions linked to your card.

---

## 4. **Request Card Closure**
You can place a closure request using any of the following channels:

### a. **Via ZX Bank Mobile App ("ZX Bank Asia")**
  1. Login to the app.
  2. Go to **Card Services** > **Credit Card Closure**.
  3. Select your card and follow the on-screen prompts.

### b. **Through ZX NetBanking**
  1. Login to ZX NetBanking.
  2. Navigate to **Cards** > **Credit Cards** > **Close Credit Card**.
  3. Select your credit card and confirm your request.

### c. **Customer Care**
  - Call 24x7 helpline:  
    - India: 1800-123-4567  
    - Sri Lanka: 011-2345678  
    - Bangladesh: 0961-234567  
  - Request card closure with your card details handy.

### d. **Branch Visit**
  - Visit your nearest ZX Bank branch.
  - Submit a written request or fill out a card closure form.

---

## 5. **Destroy the Card**
- **After confirmation,** cut your card (including chip and magnetic strip) and dispose of it securely.

---

## 6. **Obtain Closure Confirmation**
- **Closure Letter/Email:** ZX Bank will send a closure confirmation within 7 working days.
- **Check CIBIL/Credit Report:** Ensure the card appears as ‘closed’ (not ‘settled’).

---

## #### Important Notes
- Closing a credit card may affect your credit score.
- You cannot re-activate a closed card; a new application is required.
- If you see continuing charges post-closure, inform ZX Bank immediately.

For help, contact ZX Bank Customer Care via the **ZX Bank Asia** mobile app or visit [www.zxbank.asia](http://www.zxbank.asia).

---

title: Bill Payments
text:
[Page 1]
ZX Bank – Bill Payments & Auto Debit Feature
ZX Bank aims to simplify your bill management experience with its robust Bill
Payments and Auto Debit features, accessible via the ZX Bank Asia Mobile
App, NetBanking, and branch network.
Supported Bill Payment Categories
• Credit Cards (ZX Bank & other banks)
• Mobile/Postpaid Bills
• Prepaid Mobile Recharge
• DTH (Direct-to-Home TV)
• Broadband & Landline
• Electricity, Water, & Gas
• Insurance Premiums
• Educational Fees
• Municipality Taxes
• More coming soon!
Auto Debit Feature
Never miss a payment!
Set up hassle-free auto debits from your ZX Bank account or credit card for
recurring bills.
How Auto Debit Works
1. Register Online:
Enable auto debit for your chosen billers via Mobile App or NetBanking.
2. Custom Schedule:
Select the payment date (due date or preferred day prior).
3. Automated Payments:
ZX Bank automatically processes payments on your behalf.
4. Alerts & Notifications:
Get SMS/email alerts before every scheduled auto debit.
5. Manage & Cancel Anytime:
Modify or stop auto debits anytime using the “Manage Mandates” section.
1

[Page 2]
Key Features
• One-Time Setup: Easy linking of billers and mandates
• Secure Payments: Protected with OTP, biometric & device authenti-
cation
• All Major Billers Covered: Over 400+ billers across India, Sri Lanka,
Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal
• Real-Time Tracking: View payment history and upcoming debits
• AI Financial Assistant (“Zia”): Get reminders, advice, and instant
support
How To Get Started
1. Download the ZX Bank Asia Mobile App (Android/iOS)
2. Login or complete e-KYC onboarding
3. Navigate to “Bill Payments” or “Auto Debit”
• Add your biller (credit card, mobile, DTH, etc.)
• Choose “Enable Auto Debit” and set your preferences
4. Confirm & Save — you’re done!
Need Help?
• Ask “Zia” in-app for step-by-step guidance
• Visit www.zxbank.asia/support
• Call our 24x7 helpline or visit your nearest branch
Experience seamless bill payments – simplify your financial life with ZX Bank!

title: Health Insurance
text:
[Page 1]
Health Insurance
Health insurance is a type of insurance coverage that pays for medical and sur-
gical expenses incurred by the insured. It is designed to protect individuals and
families from high healthcare costs and offer access to quality medical services.
Key Features
• Coverage for Medical Expenses: Includes hospitalization, surgeries,
outpatient care, prescription drugs, diagnostics, and preventive services.
• Cashless Treatment: Many insurers offer cashless claim settlement at
network hospitals, eliminating upfront payments by the policyholder.
• Pre- and Post-Hospitalization: Expenses incurred before and after
hospitalization are often covered.
• Family Floater Plans: A single policy that covers the entire family
under one sum insured.
• Optional Add-ons: Critical illness cover, maternity benefits, accidental
benefits, and top-ups for enhanced protection.
Types of Health Insurance
• Individual Health Insurance: Covers a single person.
• Family Floater Health Insurance: Covers the entire family under one
policy.
• Senior Citizen Health Insurance: Customized for individuals above
a certain age (typically 60+).
• Critical Illness Insurance: Lump sum payout on diagnosis of specific
illnesses like cancer, heart attack, etc.
• Group Health Insurance: Provided by employers for their employees.
Benefits
• Financial Protection: Shields against expensive medical treatments.
• Access to Quality Healthcare: Facilitates timely and quality health-
care services.
• Tax Benefits: Premiums paid are eligible for tax deductions (e.g., under
Section 80D in India).
• Peace of Mind: Reduces the stress of unexpected medical emergencies.
Important Terms
Term
Description
Premium
Amount paid periodically for the policy
Sum Insured
Maximum amount insurance will cover
Pre-existing Diseases
Illnesses already present before buying
1

[Page 2]
Term
Description
Waiting Period
Tenure before certain benefits activate
Co-payment
Part of claim paid by the insured
Network Hospitals
Hospitals with direct cashless tie-ups
How to Choose a Health Insurance Plan
1. Assess Your Needs: Consider age, family size, health conditions.
2. Compare Plans: Look for coverage, exclusions, claim process, and pre-
mium.
3. Check Network Hospitals: Wide network ensures better access.
4. Understand Exclusions: Know what isn’t covered.
5. Look for Add-ons: Customize the policy for better protection.
6. Review Claim Settlement Ratio: Indicates reliability of insurer.
Common Exclusions
• Pre-existing diseases (during waiting period)
• Cosmetic treatments
• Dental and vision (unless specified)
• Self-inflicted injuries
• Non-allopathic treatments
Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Is health insurance mandatory?
A: Not in most countries, but highly recommended due to rising healthcare
costs.
Q: What happens if a claim is denied?
A: Review the reason, appeal to the insurer, or approach a regulatory authority.
Q: Can I port my health policy to another insurer?
A: Yes, most countries allow portability after certain conditions are met.
Useful Resources
• IRDAI (India’s Insurance Regulator)
• World Health Organization – Health Financing
• National Health Portal, India

What is NetBanking?
ZX Bank NetBanking is a secure online banking platform for individuals and
businesses to manage accounts, perform transactions, pay bills, and access bank-

• Account balance & statement viewing
